name: Tiroler Zugspitzbahn & Zugspitze
kurzbeschreibung: The Tyrolean Zugspitze Cable Car in Ehrwald overcomes 1,725 m of vertical gain to the 2,962 m summit with 4-country panoramas, museum, and viewing platforms.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Tyrolean Zugspitze Cable Car in Ehrwald ranks among the most breathtaking aerial tramways in the world, unlocking the 2,962-metre summit of Mount Zugspitze—the highest elevation of the Wetterstein massif and Germany—directly from Tyrolean soil. The modern large-cabin aerial tram ascends from the valley station in Ehrwald-Obermoos at 1,225 metres, conquering an astonishing 1,725 metres of vertical elevation in under ten minutes. Gliding past precipitous limestone walls, the cable car sweeps over one of the world's tallest ropeway pylons standing 85 metres high. At the summit crest, expansive panoramic observation decks unlock an awe-inspiring four-country vista spanning hundreds of peaks across Austria, Germany, Italy, and Switzerland. Attractions include the 'Fascination Zugspitze' museum, documenting the pioneering construction of Tyrol's first cableway in 1926, and a glass-bottomed viewing bay jutting over the abyss.

Route & Anforderungen

On the summit plateau, visitors can stroll between Tyrolean and Bavarian terraces via enclosed glass corridors and outdoor galleries. Reaching the actual highest point and its gilded summit cross (2,962 m) involves a brief, exposed scrambler traverse secured by steel cables (demands sure-footedness, head for heights, and sturdy mountain boots; treacherous in snow or ice). Long-distance mountaineers ascend to the summit from Ehrwald via the famous 'Gatterl' crossing through the Gaistal (approx. 5 to 6 hours strenuous climb). The summit galleries, museums, and panoramic restaurants are fully accessible via elevators and stroller-friendly.

Besuch & Anreise

The valley terminal is located in Obermoos near Ehrwald, accessible via the federal Fernpass highway B179 or toll-free from Bavaria through Garmisch-Partenkirchen. Spacious free parking is provided at the base. Rail travelers take the Außerfern Railway to Ehrwald station and transfer to the free local shuttle bus running straight to the tramway.

Tipps

Indulge in a mountain breakfast at the Panorama-Lounge 2962 restaurant to enjoy crystal-clear morning horizons, and test your courage on the transparent glass viewing floor suspended over the cliff face in the summit museum.
preis: Round trip adults approx. €65, child reductions; 'Fascination Zugspitze' museum included
oeffnungszeiten: Operates daily May to early November and December to April (maintenance periods observed)
saison: Ganzjährig (außer Revisionszeiten im Frühjahr und Spätherbst)
